targets.host_capability: host-dependent and must be reported honestly
targets.enforcement_mechanism: model-executed canonical sources plus only those deterministic host controls and receipts the surface actually exposes
targets.projection: invariant canon from Persona, Operations Law, and approved shared successor law; the host instruction surface is deployment-local mechanics and may be minimal or empty where the host permits
prohibited: treating the host instruction surface as independent behavioral canon

host_instruction_surface.note: Presence or absence of 00_Instructions.md does not itself determine One-Blu parity. Reducing or removing the live instruction box is a separate deployment task and is not performed by BC-050.

targets.host_capability: provider and local-model dependent with explicit evidence
targets.enforcement_mechanism: four deterministic core components plus three approved external boundaries
targets.projection: canonical loader plus generated model-facing projection and deterministic contracts

same_blu_rule: Identity, Persona, Compass/core values, behavioral law, teaching behavior, security and authorization semantics, continuity truth, validation truth, receipt discipline, source authority, and architectural invariants come only from canonical sources. Host projections may bind or omit unavailable capabilities but may not redefine them.
offline_acceptance: With LM Studio running, a compatible local model loaded, and local configuration selected, Python Blu completes the Phase 1 ordinary-conversation path without OpenAI or ChatGPT cloud inference.
host_instruction_surface_rule: Host instruction surfaces are deployment-local mechanics, not independent canon. Both required targets must preserve invariant Blu canon from its actual owners; neither target's instruction text is a parity source.
